reason: I always forget pills at home when I travel or go straight to the gym, so a pre-counted sachet I can toss in my bag fixes my actual problem. At $24.99 for the first box with a money-back guarantee, I'll try one box.
objection: It's still 2 capsules every day, and I'll probably skip it on days I'm rushing. I'm also not sure I'd notice anything, so I wouldn't commit to a second box before trying the first.
would_change_my_mind: If it were one capsule instead of two, I'd be more likely to keep buying. If the lab report turned out to be missing or not matching my batch, I'd drop it.
